'''Trezin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] who fought against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. While on leave at [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa's]] [[Club Ufora]], he was kidnapped by the Empire and brought to [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Charnagus]], who planned to take his body apart and graft its parts on a saboteur to take Trezin's place on the fleet. However, the Captain was rescued by the Republic before the Doctor could cause him harm.
